# vgi-rpc

> Transport-agnostic RPC framework built on Apache Arrow IPC serialization. Multi-language (Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C#, C++), no code generation required.

## Docs

- [Python Documentation](https://vgi-rpc-python.query.farm): Full Python API reference and guides
- [TypeScript Documentation](https://vgi-rpc-typescript.query.farm): TypeScript API reference and guides
- [Rust API Documentation](https://docs.rs/vgi-rpc): Rust server API reference
- [Java API Documentation](https://javadoc.io/doc/farm.query/vgirpc): Java API reference
- [C# Documentation](https://github.com/Query-farm/vgi-rpc-csharp#readme): C# API reference and guides
- [C++ Documentation](https://vgi-rpc-cpp.query.farm): C++ API reference and guides
- [Wire Protocol](https://vgi-rpc.query.farm/wire-protocol): Binary framing and message format specification
- [Benchmarks](https://vgi-rpc.query.farm/benchmarks): Performance benchmarks across transports and languages

## Key Concepts

vgi-rpc uses Apache Arrow IPC as its serialization format, giving callers zero-copy access to columnar data without schema negotiation or code generation. Clients create typed proxy objects that mirror the server's service interface; method calls are dispatched over a pluggable transport layer.

**Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, shared memory, HTTP, and worker pool. Each transport implements the same framing protocol so services are portable across deployment topologies.

**RPC Patterns:** unary (single request/response), unary void (fire-and-forget), producer (server-streaming with optional header), and exchange (bidirectional streaming with optional header).

**Arrow IPC Serialization:** Arguments and return values are encoded as Arrow record batches. Complex types, optional types, and dataclass/struct types are mapped automatically from each language's native type system.

**Typed Proxies:** Client code calls methods on a proxy object that mirrors the server interface. The proxy handles serialization, transport framing, and deserialization transparently.

## Capabilities

### Python (v0.43.0)
- **Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, shared memory, HTTP, worker pool
- **Patterns:** unary, unary void, producer (with header), exchange (with header)
- **Features:** introspection, client logging, error propagation, complex types, optional types, dataclass types, annotated types, authentication, external storage, OpenTelemetry
- **Package:** [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/vgi-rpc/)

### TypeScript (v0.22.0)
- **Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, TCP, HTTP
- **Patterns:** unary, unary void, producer (with header), exchange (with header)
- **Features:** introspection, client logging, error propagation, complex and optional types, authentication, external storage, OpenTelemetry

### Go (v0.26.0)
- **Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, TCP, HTTP, shared-memory side channel
- **Patterns:** unary, unary void, producer (with header), exchange (with header)
- **Features:** introspection, client logging, error propagation, complex and optional types, authentication, external storage, OpenTelemetry

### Rust (v0.23.0)
- **Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, TCP, HTTP, shared-memory side channel
- **Patterns:** unary, unary void, producer (with header), exchange (with header)
- **Features:** native clients and servers, derive macros, introspection v4, client logging, error propagation, complex/optional/annotated types, authentication, OpenTelemetry, sticky sessions, S3/GCS external storage
- **Package:** [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/vgi-rpc)

### Java (v0.23.0)
- **Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, TCP, HTTP, shared-memory side channel on JDK 22+
- **Patterns:** unary, unary void, producer (with header), exchange (with header)
- **Features:** typed interface proxies, introspection v4, client logging, error propagation, complex/optional/annotated types, authentication, OpenTelemetry correlation, sticky sessions, S3/GCS external storage
- **Package:** [Maven Central](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/farm.query/vgirpc)

### C# (v0.7.0)
- **Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, TCP, HTTP with identity or zstd content encoding, shared-memory side channel
- **Patterns:** unary, unary void, producer (with header), exchange (with header)
- **Features:** typed clients and servers, reflection-based POCO contracts, Arrow record batches, introspection v4, client logging, error propagation, authentication, OpenTelemetry correlation, S3/GCS external storage
- **Package:** [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/QueryFarm.VgiRpc/)

### C++ (v0.1.3)
- **Transports:** pipe, subprocess, Unix socket, TCP, HTTP, shared-memory side channel
- **Patterns:** unary, unary void, producer (with header), exchange (with header)
- **Features:** native clients and servers, introspection v4, client logging, error propagation, complex/optional/annotated types, authentication, compression, sticky sessions, external storage

## Optional

- [PyPI Package](https://pypi.org/project/vgi-rpc/): Install Python implementation via pip
- [Benchmarks](https://vgi-rpc.query.farm/benchmarks): Transport and serialization performance data
